observations.title: Normal controlled Web SEARCH selection and APPLICATION draft survives login without auto-submit
steps: Separate Chrome actor explicitly asks Find meals, receives real controller public meal card from same local database, and selects that specific card.

Normal application editor has unsent manual text. Explicit selected-meal request generates application draft; explicit transfer and replacement confirmation populate the original editor. Applications remain0.
User Send while Guest enters normal email OTP/profile. Same original target and complete draft return after profile; applications still0, no automatic send.
Only another explicit Send creates applications1, UI pending; seat_events remains1 host seat, no autoapproval.
Whole005 remains NOT_RUN for original Web/iOS role swap, B privacy, sameDB Admin and final capacity/deadline assertions. No real model/provider quality claim.
